crossRefs.note: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
“Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not…
in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized;
you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism…
before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after…
He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the…
Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

parallels.note: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
translations.bsb: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
translations.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
translations.asv: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.
